name: Mukhyamantri Amath Kaumudi Yojana
shortDescription: Annual financial assistance of ₹12,500 to women aged 45-60 in Tamil Nadu.
description: A government scheme providing annual financial assistance of ₹12,500 to women between 45-60 years of age in Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide support to women during their golden years.
sourceOrganization: Tamil Nadu Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Program Department
documents: Aadhaar card (proof of identity and address)
Proof of age (birth certificate or SSLC mark sheet)
Tamil Nadu resident proof (ration card or voter ID)
Bank account passbook (for direct benefit transfer)

rules.description: All of the following must be true.
Applicant must be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
Applicant must be at least 45 years old.
Applicant must be 60 years or younger.

applicationSteps: Visit the nearest Social Welfare Office or Women and Child Development Office in yourtaluk.
Obtain the application form from the office or download from the official website.
Fill in the application form with correct details.
Submit the application to the concerned office.
Wait for verification and approval (usually 30-45 days).
If approved, amount will be credited to your bank account.
verificationSource: Tamil Nadu Social Welfare Department official guidelines
